items.html: *We shall also explain the aspect of these breasts in the aspect of the name Eheyeh, and we shall explain it with what was said, how there are three Eheyehs — of Yudin, of Alfin, and of Hehin — and they are in its GAT, and this lower one is in the filling of Hehin and has only thirty-nine letters, because the first is of Yudin and the second of Alfin, and each one has forty-one letters: in the simple, in the filling, and in the filling of the filling. And there it was explained that the two lower Eheyehs among the three first ones, at the time of the injection of the drop of redness, ascend upward in the first Eheyeh of Yudin.
